snippet.title: LUNADUN Main Trailer(EN)
snippet.description:
Choose your favorite character and walk alongside them—
But in that moment, where does the one left behind go?

This is the official trailer for LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON, an emotionally explosive narrative adventure where every decision reshapes the characters' destinies.

Save one, and another falls into ruin.
There are no choices that lead to happiness for everyone.
At the end of your "choices and consequences," what truth awaits?
